project_type: Kubernetes-deployed FastAPI service template (PostgreSQL + Redis). Pure template: all identity/ARN values are PLACEHOLDER_* tokens so it builds before init.
language: Python 3.13 (pinned in .python-version); YAML Kubernetes manifests; GitHub Actions workflows.
build_system: uv (pyproject.toml + committed uv.lock). Tasks run via poethepoet: `uv run poe <task>`. Add deps ONLY with `uv add` / `uv add --dev`; NEVER hand-edit uv.lock; NEVER pip install. Kustomize is `kubectl kustomize` (no standalone binary).
test_framework: pytest (+ pytest-asyncio, httpx). Unit tests in tests/unit/ must run with NO services. Integration tests marked @pytest.mark.integration need Postgres+Redis.
build_command: uv run poe check  (lint + mypy --strict + pytest)
test_command: uv run poe test  (pytest); full gate: uv run poe check-all
verification_instructions: Before declaring done run, from repo root: (1) `uv run poe k8s-check` — renders deploy/k8s/overlays/dev, deploy/k8s/overlays/prod, and deploy/argocd; runs kubeconform TWICE (pass a lenient with -ignore-missing-schemas + -schema-location default + deploy/k8s/crd-schemas; pass b scoped to CRD-bearing renders with -ignore-missing-schemas REMOVED and -schema-location pointing ONLY at deploy/k8s/crd-schemas, core kinds excluded via -skip, so an unresolved Application/ExternalSecret/ClusterSecretStore FAILS the build); kube-linter on dev/prod ONLY; confirm `kubectl kustomize deploy/argocd` emits ClusterSecretStore with NO metadata.namespace. (2) `uv run poe docs-build` (mkdocs build --strict). (3) `uv run poe check`. (4) `uv run poe security` (gitleaks + ruff S + scripts/check_sops_encrypted.py). (5) `rg PLACEHOLDER_` lists only intended tokens. (6) Validate .github/workflows/sync-secrets.yml with actionlint if available else `python -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open(...))"` + `pre-commit run check-yaml`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: uv.lock is generated by `uv add` and committed. No other generated/snapshot files for this task.
environment_constraints: actionlint is NOT installed locally (use YAML-parse + pre-commit check-yaml fallback). kubectl, kubeconform, kube-linter, yq (mikefarah), sops, uv ARE available locally. CI pins kubeconform 0.8.0 and kube-linter 0.8.3. Argo CD and ESO are ASSUMED pre-installed cluster-level (like the Datadog Agent) — this repo does NOT install them. No worktree: work on branch main in repo root; HEAD is unborn so the first commit is the repo's first commit.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md + SPEC.md §14: read SPEC.md first; do not change a §2 choice without recording it in docs/adr/ and SPEC.md (this task does exactly that in ADR 0001 IN PLACE — do NOT create a new ADR). Use poe tasks, not raw tools (local==CI). Conventional Commits (feeds git-cliff; commit-msg hook enforces). Never commit plaintext secrets; only SOPS-encrypted deploy/**/secrets.*.yaml. Security suppressions (# noqa: S..., kube-linter ignores) need a written reason on the same line or in the ignore file. New values a project must supply are PLACEHOLDER_<NAME> tokens, registered in .template/placeholders.yml, kept as valid strings. mypy --strict for new Python; no blanket type: ignore. Stage specific files (NOT git add -A); NO --no-verify; prefer new commits over --amend.
key_patterns: Secret consumed by deployment.yaml AND migration-job.yaml is already named `app-secrets` via `envFrom: secretRef: app-secrets` — NO rename needed. ESO's ExternalSecret is named app-secrets-external with target.name: app-secrets (distinct name avoids a get/bootstrap readability trap). ClusterSecretStore MUST live in deploy/argocd/ (no namespace: transformer) so it renders cluster-scoped; placing it in base would get namespaced by both overlays. Backup pod MUST carry label app.kubernetes.io/name: k8s-fastapi-starter (load-bearing: the `app` NetworkPolicy podSelector matches on it; without it egress to Postgres/S3/STS/KMS/Secrets Manager is denied and backups silently fail) plus app.kubernetes.io/component: backup. Backup SA needs automountServiceAccountToken: true for IRSA (differs from the `app` SA which has false). One JSON secret per env named k8s-fastapi-starter/<env>/app-secrets with keys DATABASE_URL + REDIS_URL. ESO apiVersion external-secrets.io/v1 requires ESO >= v0.10.0 (hard floor — manifest apiVersion, vendored _v1.json filenames, and docs must agree). sync-secrets yq is the mikefarah build (the @base64d operator is mikefarah-specific; preinstalled on ubuntu-latest). kubeconform schema-location template intentionally omits the API group (kind+version is unique here). bootstrap_backups.py follows scripts/check_sops_encrypted.py conventions: module docstring, typed, argparse, main(argv: list[str]) -> int.
relevant_files: SPEC.md (§1,§2,§3,§6,§9,§10,§13 to edit; §7 migration ordering; §9 secrets)
deploy/k8s/base/migration-job.yaml (PreSync hook; study security posture to mirror for backup)
deploy/k8s/base/deployment.yaml (consumes secretRef: app-secrets — do not break)
deploy/k8s/.kube-linter.yaml (empty exclude: []; add exclusion only if a check fires, with reason)
pyproject.toml ([tool.poe.tasks.k8s-check] to rewrite; add boto3 dev deps)
.github/workflows/deploy.yml (DELETE; reuse its sops install + configure-aws-credentials pinned SHAs in sync-secrets.yml)
.github/workflows/ci.yml (k8s job already installs kubeconform/kube-linter + calls poe k8s-check; reuse its checkout SHA)
.template/placeholders.yml (register new tokens; extend PROJECT_SLUG.replace_in; update external referenced_in)
docs/deployment.md, docs/secrets.md, docs/architecture.md (rewrite for the new flow)
directory_structure: deploy/k8s/base/ (serviceaccount, configmap, deployment, service, networkpolicy, migration-job, kustomization) + deploy/k8s/overlays/{dev,prod}/ (kustomization, secrets.example.yaml; prod adds pdb.yaml). NEW: deploy/argocd/ (Applications + ClusterSecretStore, no namespace: transformer) and deploy/k8s/crd-schemas/ (vendored CRD JSON schemas). src/app/ is the FastAPI app. scripts/ holds operator scripts. tests/unit + tests/integration. docs/ + docs/adr/ is MkDocs TechDocs. .github/workflows/ holds ci.yml, release.yml, security.yml (deploy.yml to be deleted, sync-secrets.yml added).
